notes: Country determination: Germany (Leipzig address on plan set 'Lausicker Str. 26, 04299 Leipzig', German-language drawings, EU license plate 'L KD 3455', clinker brick base, roller shutters). Certainty: very high. Calc profile DE.
Plan set 1:100, luka architekten, 11.06.2012, 8 sheets, one project. Building is a ~1930s villa with hip roof, clinker base and clinker accents on stucco.

Functional mapping: front = Ansicht von Nordosten (street, entry door), back = Ansicht von Südwesten (garden, veranda + balcony), right (seen from street) = SE side (garage side), left = NW side (Ansicht von Nordwesten).
Sloped site: grade zero (±0.00) at street/entry side; garden side approx. 1.13 m lower per plan level marks (-1.13 / -1.11).
Section sheet scanned in correct orientation; levels read: -1.15 KG, +0.94 EG, +4.05 OG, +7.28/+7.57 DG, +10.07 Spitzboden, +12.225 ridge, eave +7.345 on elevations.
Roof geometry assumes equal pitch on all four hip facets (ridge = 12.94 - 10.00 = 2.94 m at wall line, 3.08 m at roof outline); section pitch annotation is partly illegible - see warnings.

warnings: Plan vs. photo: plan sheets 2/4 mark planned solar panels and 3 roof windows (red) on the SW roof; photos show 2 skylights plus one flat panel (likely solar collector) as built - photo state used (SK-1, SK-2, AT-10).
Plan vs. photo: SW elevation marks 'Brüstung abbrechen' (parapet demolition) at kitchen window; photo 8 shows the widened band window as built - photo geometry used for W-14.
Openings likely undercounted on front: photos 6/9 are 25-30% occluded by fence, vehicles and vegetation; basement windows W-11/W-12 taken from plan only.
Openings likely undercounted on back at basement level: vegetation covers the plinth in photo 8.
Balcony-level openings W-17 and D-2 partially occluded by railing - low confidence, arrangement may differ.

Roof geometry: ridge length 3080 mm assumes equal pitch on all four hip facets; the partly illegible pitch annotation on the section sheet could indicate a steeper cross pitch, which would lengthen the ridge (up to ~6 m) and change hip lengths. Roof facet areas keep medium confidence.
Front elevation downspouts not visible in any photo - downspout count likely undercounted on front.
Dormer windows W-18/W-19/W-20 and eyebrow window W-13 sit on dormer faces for which no WL faces are emitted; parent_face_id set to null per OPENING PARENT RULE.
Ground line occluded by bins/IBC/vegetation on right and left elevations; grade offsets taken from plan level marks (±0.00 / -1.13), not from photos.
Reference disagreement: vehicle-length chain (photo 6) and license-plate chain (photo 9) agree within ~3% of the plan width 12.94 m - plan value kept (high).
Wall dimension check: WL-3/WL-4 use an average height 7910 mm on the sloping side grade; width x height equals area by construction, but actual grade varies ±565 mm along the face.

No pipe or vent penetrations identifiable in any photo apart from the two chimneys and the probable solar panel (AT-10); penetration count may be zero-biased because roof planes are only seen from ground level.
